one_liner: Ecommerce‑focused helpdesk and AI platform (built for Shopify) that unifies email, chat, social, SMS, and voice support.
access_notes: Any Gorgias account (free 7‑day trial or paid) can generate API credentials; public apps require review to be listed.
mcp_notes: Official Gorgias MCP for Claude/ChatGPT and generic HTTP MCP clients; available on all Helpdesk plans.
blocker_notes: You can build and test immediately (trial + sandbox) and ship OAuth2, but broad multi‑tenant distribution/listing in the Gorgias App Store requires app review; customers need an active Gorgias workspace.

evidence.quote: The Gorgias API supports two authentication methods: 1. Private app → API key 2. Public app → OAuth2
